title: API Design for Production: Status Codes, Pagination, Idempotency & Safe Changes
concept: Design HTTP APIs that clients can build on for years: resources and status codes clients can act on, one error contract, cursor pagination with a stable order, filters and sorts from an allowlist, idempotency keys for safe retries, concurrency control, rate limit headers, and changing a contract without breaking the apps that use it.
description: An intermediate course for backend developers whose API now has more than one client. Every lesson starts from an incident on the CodeDev learning platform's API - a mobile app that crashed after a field was renamed, a learner charged twice because the app retried a POST, page 2 of the catalog repeating a course from page 1 while instructors were publishing, a sort parameter that let anyone sort by password hash, three different error formats in one API - and fixes it with a contract you can test: resources and methods, status codes, an error contract, cursor pagination, an AI-written offset pagination bug, safe filtering and sorting, idempotency keys, ETags and If-Match, rate limit headers, the Ship a Breaking Change Safely scenario, automatic compatibility checks, and OpenAPI with versioning and deprecation. 12 lessons with True/False quizzes on real requests, responses and diffs, and TypeScript challenges graded by hidden tests.

learningOutcomes.text: Design resources and choose status codes that clients can act on
Return one error contract with code, message, details and a trace id
Paginate with stable cursors and filter and sort only by allowed fields
Make writes safe to retry with idempotency keys and handle concurrent updates
Change an API without breaking clients and detect breaking changes automatically

lessons.title: Choose status codes clients can act on
